workday_def: Full-time: 8 hours per day, 6 days per week.
Men: 8 hours per day, 48 hours per week. Women and workers under 18: 8 hours per day, 40 hours per week.
8 hours per day, 5 or 5.5 days per week.
45 hours per week, set to be progressively reduced across the span of 5 years to 40 hours per week starting on 2023.
8 hours per day, 6 days per week until July 14, 2023. Maximum workweek set to be progressively reduced between 2023 and 2026 from 48 to 42 hours.
8 hours per day, 5.5 days per week. Monthly full time is equivalent to 23.83 days. Full workday is equivalent to 8 hours.
8 hours per day, 5 days per week. Full-time month equivalent to 160 hours.
8 hours per day, 5 days per week.

Day shift: 8 hours per day. Night shift: 7 hours per day. Mixed shift: 7.5 hours per day. Full-time workweek: 48 hours (6 days a week). Reform in progress to reduce the full-time workweek to 40 hours (5 days per week).
Day shift: 8 hours per day, 6 days per week. Night shift: 7 hours per day, 6 days per week.
8 hours per day, 6 days per week.
parttime_def: Applies to those working less than 2/3 of full time per week (32 hours). Legal daily MW: 1/25 of monthly MW. Legal hourly MW: 1/8 of daily MW.
The law allows prorated part-time employment, with payment proportional to the full-time MW.
Applies to those working 30 hours per week or less with no overtime, and to those working 26 hours per week or less with a maximum overtime of 6 hours. Earnings proportional to the full-time MW.
2/3 of full time is considered part-time. Payment proportional to the full-time MW.
Part-time MW proportional to the monthly MW.
29 hours per week or less is considered part-time. Payment proportional to the full-time MW.
Less than 40 hours a week is considered part-time. Payment of wages and benefits proportional to the full-time MW. Non-divisible benefits paid in full.

Applies to those working at least 3 hours a day and not full-time. Payment proportional to full-time. Firms with more than 10 workers can hire a maximum of 40% of their workers under this type of contract.
Applies to those working less than 48 hours per week. The monthly payment is equivalent to 30 times the daily MW.
16 to 32 hours per week is considered part-time. Any work contract that surpasses 32 hours a week is considered full time. Daily MW: 1/26 of monthly MW.
Up to 4 hours per day on average, 5 or 6 days a week, is considered part-time. Payment proportional to the monthly MW.
